verdict.rationale: Logseq's local HTTP API server accepts a user-created bearer token for authorization, but nothing in the evidence shows those tokens can be scoped, permission-limited, or restricted to least privilege. Any token grants access to the single `/api` endpoint, which dispatches any plugin API method. A plain all-access token is an adjacent feature, not the scoped-credential capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
